messages:
maria: Heads up 1: marketing needs the final one-liner benchmark stat + canonical changelog URL for the Monday launch post. Also confirm rollout window (we plan to publish at start of rollout). @sam @jess

sam: One-liner benchmark: "~2.9x throughput improvement on long-context inference vs v1 (internal, see methodology)". Keeping it conservative.

jess: Changelog canonical URL: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/v2.0/changelog (already updated).

ci-bot: Build artifacts for release/v2 created at 2025-06-06T18:45:00Z.

maria: Rollout time? We originally discussed 14:00 PT Friday, is that locked?

sam: Ops updated to 14:30 PT to give extra buffer. Canary start 14:30 PT, 2-hour ramp.

legal: Confirmed no embargo; contents cleared for public release at rollout time.

maria: Thanks. I'll draft the post with those exact links and the webinar CTA. Will ping for final sign-off at 4pm PT.

sam: A couple quick asks for the post: please include a note that Dedicated customers will need to opt in for the upgrade, and link to the private deployment guide.

maria: Yep will include. Draft incoming :email:

jess: I'll add a short note on benchmark methodology to the benchmarks page to avoid questions.

maria: Great, appreciate the quick turn. :tada:
